music: Existing theme low; tension from quiet controlled spaces, not horror scoring. No triumphant combat montage.
mix: Near -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP. Effects below aligned narration.

new_assets.prompt: Open courtyard by day: light wind, a few sandals on sand, distant birds. No crowd, no music.
A blunt wooden sword striking a wooden post once, dull knock. No metal clang.
Two steps and a reset of feet on sand, soft. No gravel crunch.
A heavy wooden gate leaf swung and closed, a low thud and a latch. No slam or chain.
A wooden practice sword and shield set down on a timber bench, two soft knocks.
Three slow footsteps on a stone corridor floor, slight echo.
A woollen blanket folded and set down, one soft movement.
Quiet enclosed water: a basin's surface disturbed once, a drip, hollow room tone. No modern tap.
A small oil lamp lit: one soft flare and a steady faint flicker.
Empty arena by day: wind across sand, a distant murmur of a few voices far off. No roaring crowd.
